Messages.Author: Agamemnon
Messages.Body:
so if I block and use

Concealed Weapon
Library

Only usable before range is determined.
This minion equips with a non-unique weapon card from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal). The weapon cannot cost 3 or more pool or inflict (with a regular strike) aggravated damage or 4 or more damage.

to equip

Sniper Rifle
Library

Weapon, gun.
2R damage each strike. Only usable at long range. If the bearer blocks an action, he or she may, before range is determined, set the range for the first round of the resulting combat to long; if he or she does so, skip the determine range step that round, and the bearer's initial strike that round must be with this weapon.

do I get to set the range, or did I miss that window?

Hindsight is foresight because we walk in circles

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Missed it.
Sniper Rifle only gets to trigger its "If the bearer blocks" when the block attempt is successful. Concealed Weapon happens during the combat after the block.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418
